content: Just want to comment that this is a well thought out step. Keeping the heatbed out the way using this method recognises that us humans only have a max of 2 hands.

In my case the front LED cable is too short for me to lean the headbed againt the back of the printer.
I had to unscrew the cable cover to have some slack.

replies.content: My cables were to short too so I zip tied the heat bed to the rear lead screw.
